tagline: A free extension: one-click sign-in and registration with Google, Facebook and X on the sign-in page, at checkout and anywhere you place the buttons.
key_features: Buttons on sign-in, registration and checkout
Safe linking of existing customer accounts
Linked Accounts grid in the admin

benefits.title: Sign up in one click
benefits.text: Shoppers use the account they already have. No form to fill in and no new password to remember.

benefits.title: Sign in at checkout
benefits.text: The buttons sit in the checkout sign-in popup and above the email field, right where shoppers decide.

benefits.title: Safe by design
benefits.text: Every ID token is validated and accounts are only linked when the email address can be trusted.

showcase.label: Sign-in page
showcase.title: One click instead of a form
showcase.text: Buttons above the sign-in and registration forms. Icon and text or icon only, light or dark, in the order you choose.

showcase.label: Checkout
showcase.title: Sign in without leaving the checkout
showcase.text: The "Sign In" popup on the checkout page and the authentication popup show the same buttons, so returning customers check out faster.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä templates
showcase.text: Alpine.js and Tailwind templates for Hyvä 1.3+, picked automatically. Luma, Blank and their child themes work out of the box.

showcase.label: Mobile
showcase.title: Made for small screens
showcase.text: Buttons stack into full-width rows on phones, where typing an email address and a password is hardest.

showcase.label: My Account
showcase.title: Customers manage their connections
showcase.text: My Account › Connected Accounts lists the linked providers. Customers connect another one or disconnect one, but never the last way to sign in.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: One settings page, per store view
showcase.text: Choose where the buttons appear, how they look, what happens after sign-in and which customer group new accounts join.

showcase.label: Provider setup
showcase.title: The exact callback URL, ready to copy
showcase.text: Each provider shows the callback URL to register for the current store view, with short setup steps. Secrets are stored encrypted.
